description: Check a token contract against the Tokenized Asset Map: is it the issuer's own contract for a tokenized fund or security on that chain? Verdicts: official, other-chain (the address is listed, but on another chain), impostor (a listed symbol on this chain, a different contract), unknown (not in the map, which says nothing either way).

address.description: The contract: 0x address, Solana mint, Stellar CODE:ISSUER, Aptos/Sui type tag, …

chain.description: The chain the contract is on.

symbol.description: The symbol the token shows (optional), to catch impostors.

name: check_token_contract
title: Is this the real tokenized security?
